lines.t: His spirit pours on every nation,
Each heart, each soul, each generation.
Man and woman, child and friend,
His breath of life has no end.
Who has heard and truly known,
Who has welcomed what He’s shown?
A child of light is standing still,
Her heart aligned with holy will.
In her thirst, the truth is found,
His righteousness is all around.
Across the earth His voice goes out,
In quiet hearts it casts out doubt.
Through humble faith, through childlike eyes,
The fire of heaven never dies.
Who has listened, who has heard,
The living pulse within His word?
A child of light is standing still,
Her heart aligned with holy will.
In her thirst, the truth is found,
His righteousness is all around.
Even young, her spirit soars,
She seeks the truth, her soul implores.
Hunger deep and vision clear,
The sound of heaven draws her near.
A child of light, her voice will sing,
Echoing pure, awakening spring.
The gift He gave, her heart embraced,
Through her the world is graced.
His spirit poured, it still remains,
On every heart that calls His name.
The child of light has heard the call,
His love, His truth—embracing all.
